name: Pizzeria Treff
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Treff in Tirol**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Treff** in the heart of **Tirol**—where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the Alps! Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Pizza Salami**, or a crispy **Focaccia**, our wood-fired pizzas are baked fresh to order in our traditional stone oven.

Pair your meal with a cold **Radler** (beer-mix) or a refreshing **Apfelschorle** (apple juice spritzer) and enjoy the cozy atmosphere of our rustic **Stube** (dining room). After dinner, indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**—a fluffy, caramelized Austrian pancake—served with powdered sugar and fresh fruit.

Located just a short stroll from **Innsbruck’s** Old Town, **Pizzeria Treff** is the perfect spot for a relaxed evening with friends or a quick bite before exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**. Come taste the difference—where Italian passion meets Alpine hospitality!

**Opening Hours:**
Mon–Thu: 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM
Fri–Sat: 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM
Sun: 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM

*We look forward to welcoming you!*
